findings.message: The fix itself covers the class. The loop checks 1440, 768 and 390 px, and 390 falls in the ≤480 px rule (welcome.css:57) where the defect was, so the 64 px check would have failed before the CSS fix. Side effect: the loop never resets the viewport, so everything after it now runs only at 390×900. That covers the play click, the focus-on-play check, the Tab/Shift+Tab reachability loop and the Space round trip. These checks used to run at the 1280×720 desktop default and no longer run on the desktop layout at all. Fix: reset the viewport after the loop (`page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 720 })`), or put the size check in its own test so the keyboard checks keep their earlier conditions.
findings.scenario: A desktop-only layout change (e.g. something visible only above 900 px is inserted between the Queue tabpanel's last button and the video) breaks Tab order at 1280 px → the test stays green, because the keyboard checks now run only at 390 px.
